name: cell division cycle associated 7 like
pathways: positive regulation of cell population proliferation

function.text: CDCA7L encodes cell division cycle-associated 7-like protein. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of cell population proliferation.

function.text: CDCA7L encodes cell division cycle-associated 7-like protein. It contributes to transcriptional regulation as a repressor that inhibits monoamine oxidase A (MAOA) activity and gene expression by binding to the promoter.
